help.donut: Each slice is one answer option; its size is the share of people who chose it. Hover a slice for exact numbers.
help.bar: Each bar is one option. Longer bars mean more people chose it. For checkboxes, shares can add up to more than 100% because people pick several.
help.column: Each column is one possible score. Taller columns mean more people gave that score.
help.line: The line connects counts over time or over the scale, so you can see the direction.
help.area: The shaded area shows how many answers fall on each date.
help.histogram: Answers are grouped into equal ranges. Each column counts the answers within its range.
help.stats: Summary numbers: the median is the middle answer, and half of all answers lie between the 25th and 75th percentiles.
help.weekday: Counts per weekday of the dates people entered.
help.terms: The most frequent words in the answers (common words removed). It shows topics, not sentiment.
help.table: The exact numbers behind the chart.
help.kpis: Headline numbers for the current filters. Trends compare the last 7 days with the 7 days before.
help.timeline: How many responses arrived per hour, day or week (depending on the date range).
help.heatmap: Darker cells mean more responses at that weekday and hour (Jakarta time).
help.split: Share of responses per device or interface language.
help.cross: Compares answers between two questions. A pattern here is a possible relationship, not proof of causation.
help.kpi: A single number computed from the responses that match the current filters.

insights.overviewNew: {total} responses in total; {last7} in the last 7 days.
insights.crossGroups: Average {measure} is highest for {top} ({topMean}) and lowest for {bottom} ({bottomMean}).
insights.crossPositive: Correlation r = {r} ({strength}): higher values tend to go together.
insights.crossNegative: Correlation r = {r} ({strength}): when one is higher, the other tends to be lower.
insights.crossFewPairs: Only {n} people answered both; at least 30 are needed for a correlation.

help.kpi: The headline number for the responses that match the filters.
help.bar: Longer bars mean larger values. Hover for exact numbers.
help.column: Taller columns mean larger values. With a colour breakdown, each colour is one group.
help.line: Lines show the direction of change. With a colour breakdown, each line is one group.
help.area: Areas show volume over time; stacked areas add groups up.
help.donut: Each slice is a part of the whole.
help.table: Each row is one group; number columns follow the chosen values.
help.pivot: Each cell is the value for that row and column combination.
help.heatmap: Darker cells mean larger values; every cell prints its number.
help.scatter: Each dot is one response. An upward pattern means both values tend to rise together; it is not proof of cause.
help.histogram: Each column is one range of values; its height is the number of responses in that range.
